entities.name: Large fluorinated substrate
observations: Formula is C38H35F6N3O5; it contains one pyridine nitrogen, one tertiary amide/lactam nitrogen, and one amide NH.

entities.name: Chloroperoxybenzoic acid
observations: SELFIES decoding gives O=C(OO)C1=CC=CC(Cl)=C1, a chloroperoxybenzoic acid oxidant analogous to mCPBA.
It is a reagent rather than an incorporated coupling partner.

entities.name: Pyridine N-oxidation
observations: mCPBA-type peroxyacid in dichloromethane commonly oxidizes pyridine nitrogen to pyridine N-oxide.
The most plausible product is the large substrate with its pyridine N converted to N(+)-O(-), while the amide/lactam nitrogen remains unchanged.
